title: Chicago Rapper Big Mulla Has Strong Message For Yung Miami And Name Drops Diddy In The Process [Listen]
htmlContent:
Chicago rapper dissing Big Mulla is the latest in a series of diss tracks aimed at Yung Miami, a member of the popular female rap duo, City Girls. The diss track was released in response to comments made by Yung Miami about Big Mulla's appearance and her stage name. In the song, Chicago rapper not only fires back at Yung Miami, but also name drops Diddy, claiming she won't be in the limelight for long. Stating , "You knew you weren't going to last long that's why you started f***ing Diddy."

Yung Miami responded in The Neighborhood Talks comments, "Booooo, she said.

However, the couple are no longer together as of last month in an interview with Billboard that she was single.

I’m single, baby," Miami chimed in. "What man you saw me with? I’m single. S-I-N-G-L-E, baby!"

I'm not sharing my next n***!"

Last December Diddy shared that Yung Miami wasn't his side and never will be.

"[Yung Miami] is not my side chick," Puff tweeted. "Never has been, never will be. She's very important and special to me, and I don't play about my Shawty Wop. I don't discuss things on the internet and I will not start today."

adding, "So think what you want," added  Diddy. "But know that if you do something to hurt mine, I'm gonna come to your house and we're gonna talk about it like human beings. Love."
